zh_CN: 【背景：星见医院病房。周一上午。】
en: [Background: Hoshimi Hospital ward. Monday morning.]

zh_CN: 【坂口接到病房通知，仓本千早因再次出现下腹胀痛和不规律出血住院。】
en: [The ward notifies Sakaguchi that Chihaya Kuramoto has been admitted again with lower abdominal bloating, pain, and irregular bleeding.]

zh_CN: 「仓本千早……上次已经处理了眼前能看到的病灶，怎么又回来了？」
en: “Chihaya Kuramoto... We dealt with the lesions we could see last time. Why is she back?”

zh_CN: 【坂口推门。千早半坐在床上，脸色很不好。瑞穗坐在一旁，手里拿着一本原本准备带来解闷的杂志。】
en: [Sakaguchi opens the door. Chihaya is propped up in bed, looking unwell. Mizuho sits beside her, holding a magazine she had brought to help pass the time.]

zh_CN: 「……坂口医生。」
en: “...Dr. Sakaguchi.”

zh_CN: 「千早小姐。听说你这几天又不舒服了。」
en: “Miss Chihaya. I hear you've been feeling unwell again these past few days.”

zh_CN: 「医生，我先问一句。」
en: “Doctor, let me ask one thing first.”

zh_CN: 「什么？」
en: “What is it?”

zh_CN: 「这次不会又要说『开刀』吧？」
en: “You're not going to say ‘surgery’ again, are you?”

zh_CN: 【坂口没有立刻回答。】
en: [Sakaguchi does not answer immediately.]

zh_CN: 「你不说话更吓人啊！！」
en: “Not saying anything is even scarier!!”

zh_CN: 「千早，先听医生怎么说。」
en: “Chihaya, let's hear what the doctor has to say.”

zh_CN: 「我当然知道要听！可是我已经开过两次了耶！两次！」
en: “I know I should listen! But I've already had two operations! Two!”

zh_CN: 【她竖起两根手指，才一用力坐直，又因腹部不适慢慢靠回枕头。】
en: [She holds up two fingers. As soon as she tries to sit straighter, the discomfort in her abdomen makes her slowly sink back against the pillow.]

zh_CN: 「第二次结束的时候，我明明说过——这辈子绝对不想再上第三次手术台！」
en: “When the second one was over, I said it—I never, ever wanted to get on an operating table a third time!”

zh_CN: 「我记得。」
en: “I remember.”

zh_CN: 「那你们倒是别让我第三次来嘛……」
en: “Then don't make me come back a third time...”

zh_CN: 【玩笑说到最后，千早的声音低下去。】
en: [As the joke trails off, Chihaya's voice grows quiet.]

zh_CN: 「……我真的以为已经好了。」
en: “...I really thought I was better.”

zh_CN: 「所以今天我们才要把原因真正弄清楚。我已经请御園医生把之前的影像和两次手术记录重新对照。」
en: “That's why we need to find the real cause today. I've asked Dr. Misono to compare your previous scans with the records from both operations.”

zh_CN: 「御園……医生？」
en: “Dr... Misono?”

zh_CN: 「是影像科的医生吗？」
en: “Is she a radiologist?”

zh_CN: 「对。她看过一些我非常重视的病例。」
en: “Yes. She's reviewed some cases that matter a great deal to me.”

zh_CN: 「……拜托了。我已经不想再经历一次『这次应该没问题』了。」
en: “...Please. I don't want to go through another ‘It should be fine this time.’”

zh_CN: 「我明白。」
en: “I understand.”

zh_CN: 【转场：影像阅片室。】
en: [Transition: the imaging review room.]

zh_CN: 【屏幕上依次出现千早初诊、第二次手术前以及本次入院的影像。手术记录、病理简报与近期检查结果放在桌边。御園芹香站在屏幕前。水城阿库娅也在场。】
en: [The screen displays Chihaya's scans from her first visit, before the second operation, and from this admission in sequence. Surgical records, a pathology summary, and recent test results lie beside the desk. Serika Misono stands before the screen. Aqua Mizuki is also present.]

zh_CN: 「先看第一次的图。这里是当时认为与右侧附件有关的囊性病灶。」
en: “First, look at the initial scan. This is the cystic lesion we believed was associated with the right adnexa.”

zh_CN: 「没错。靠得太近了，最初看起来确实很像妇科来源。」
en: “That's right. It was so close that it really did look gynecological in origin at first.”

zh_CN: 「第二次切除的部分也在这里。但我想让你们注意的是旁边的血管走向。」
en: “The portion removed during the second operation was here, too. But I want you to notice the course of the adjacent vessels.”

zh_CN: 【芹香切换影像，依次放大相同区域。】
en: [Serika switches between the scans, enlarging the same region in each.]

zh_CN: 「如果它只是附件附近一处独立的囊肿，周围结构不应该连续几次出现这样的位移。」
en: “If this were simply an isolated cyst near the adnexa, we shouldn't see this repeated displacement of the surrounding structures.”

zh_CN: 「……肠系膜血管的分支？」
en: “...Branches of the mesenteric vessels?”

zh_CN: 「是。再看肠管的位置。这组分隔状的囊性结构并不是从盆腔中心向外扩张。更像是从上方沿着肠系膜间隙延伸下来。」
en: “Yes. Now look at the bowel's position. This group of septated cystic structures isn't expanding outward from the center of the pelvis. It looks more like it's extending down from above along the mesenteric spaces.”

zh_CN: 「也就是说，我们前两次看到的可能只是它伸到盆腔里的部分？」
en: “So what we saw the first two times may have been only the part extending into the pelvis?”

zh_CN: 「我怀疑是这样。」
en: “That's my suspicion.”

zh_CN: 「先天性肠系膜囊性病变……比如淋巴管畸形一类。」
en: “A congenital mesenteric cystic lesion... Something like a lymphatic malformation.”

zh_CN: 「目前影像最支持这个方向，但最终性质需要病理确认。我不想只凭这几张图给它定名。」
en: “That's what the imaging currently supports most strongly, but pathology will have to confirm its nature. I don't want to name it based on these scans alone.”

zh_CN: 【阿库娅重新翻看手术记录。】
en: [Aqua looks through the surgical records again.]

zh_CN: 「第二次手术时子宫和双侧附件都很健康。我们处理了盆腔里实际能看到的囊性组织，却一直解释不了它为什么会反复出现。」
en: “During the second operation, the uterus and both adnexa were healthy. We treated the cystic tissue we could actually see in the pelvis, but we never managed to explain why it kept recurring.”

zh_CN: 「因为真正的起点可能在妇科术野之外。」
en: “Because its true origin may lie outside the gynecological operative field.”

zh_CN: 「对。若这次决定手术，我建议以普通外科的解剖路径重新观察，尤其确认病灶与小肠系膜和相关血管的实际连接。」
en: “Exactly. If you decide to operate this time, I suggest approaching it through general surgical anatomy, particularly to establish the lesion's actual connections to the small-bowel mesentery and its vessels.”

zh_CN: 「我负责决定术式和主刀。术前准备还需要根据这条线索重新安排。」
en: “I'll decide the procedure and lead the operation. We'll need to revise the preoperative preparations in light of this finding.”

zh_CN: 「……这样就好。」
en: “...Good.”

zh_CN: 【芹香收起影像笔。】
en: [Serika puts away her imaging pointer.]

zh_CN: 「御園医生，谢谢你。比起只告诉我『有个东西又长出来了』，这条证据很重要。」
en: “Thank you, Dr. Misono. This evidence matters much more than simply being told ‘Something has grown back.’”

zh_CN: 「这是报告里应该写清楚的内容。」
en: “It's something the report should make clear.”

zh_CN: 【芹香的语气依然平淡，目光却迎上了坂口。】
en: [Serika's tone remains level, but her eyes meet Sakaguchi's.]

zh_CN: 「那就由普通外科来解决根源吧。我会从妇科角度协助确认盆腔器官。」
en: “Then let's have general surgery address the source. I'll help assess the pelvic organs from the gynecological side.”
“All right.”

zh_CN: 【坂口与阿库娅回到千早病房。】
en: [Sakaguchi and Aqua return to Chihaya's room.]

zh_CN: 「我们找到了此前一直没注意到的重要线索。病灶的来源很可能不是子宫或卵巢，而是延伸到盆腔的肠系膜囊性病变。」
en: “We've found an important clue we missed before. The lesion most likely originates not in the uterus or ovaries, but in a mesenteric cystic lesion extending into the pelvis.”
“...And that means?”

zh_CN: 「需要再进行一次手术，顺着真正的解剖来源处理，而不只是切掉盆腔里看见的部分。」
en: “We'll need to operate again, following its true anatomical origin rather than only removing the part visible in the pelvis.”

zh_CN: 【千早僵住。】
en: [Chihaya freezes.]

zh_CN: 「果然还是要开啊……」
en: “So you really do have to cut me open again...”
“Chihaya...”

zh_CN: 「我知道医生不是故意的。我也知道上两次真的帮我好多了……」
en: “I know you didn't mean for this to happen. And I know the first two operations really helped...”

zh_CN: 「可是术前那些事情、那个手术室、那些器械，我只要想一想就——」
en: “But all the things before surgery, that operating room, those instruments... Just thinking about them makes me—”

zh_CN: 【她将双手压在被子上，拼命忍住眼泪。】
en: [She presses both hands against the blanket, fighting desperately to hold back tears.]

zh_CN: 「这次我们已经知道该往哪里找。前两次并不是白做的；它们留下的记录，让今天的判断有了依据。」
en: “This time, we know where to look. The first two operations weren't for nothing; the records they left us are what made today's assessment possible.”

zh_CN: 「那……这次谁开？」
en: “Then... who's operating this time?”

zh_CN: 「我主刀。阿库娅医生协助。」
en: “I'll lead. Dr. Aqua will assist.”

zh_CN: 「等等！那护士呢？七濑护士一定也在吧？」
en: “Wait! What about the nurses? Nurse Nanase will definitely be there, right?”

zh_CN: 「咦？连护士都要指定？」
en: “Oh? You're requesting specific nurses, too?”

zh_CN: 「当然啦！医龙团队怎么可以随便换人！」
en: “Of course! You can't just swap people out of my Team Medical Dragon!”

zh_CN: 「还有留美姐姐！她上次虽然老爱开我玩笑，可是又漂亮又能干！我想请她也来！」
en: “And Rumi! She kept teasing me last time, but she's so pretty and capable! I want her there, too!”

zh_CN: 「还有上次那位巡回护士姐姐！她虽然老爱开我玩笑，可是又漂亮又能干！我想请她也来！」
en: “And that circulating nurse from last time! She kept teasing me, but she's so pretty and capable! I want her there, too!”

zh_CN: 「哈哈，你现在开刀还挑起医护人员来了？」
en: “Haha, now you're choosing your own surgical team?”

zh_CN: 「放心。七濑护士和上次的巡回护士都已经排进这台手术了。」
en: “Don't worry. Nurse Nanase and the circulating nurse from last time are already assigned to this operation.”

zh_CN: 「真的？太好了！至少不是一屋子陌生人……」
en: “Really? Thank goodness! At least it won't be a room full of strangers...”

zh_CN: 「……坂口医生。」
en: “...Dr. Sakaguchi.”

zh_CN: 「我上次说过，要是第三次是你开，我就不跑。」
en: “Last time, I said that if you did the third operation, I wouldn't run away.”

zh_CN: 「我记得。」
en: “I remember.”

zh_CN: 「现在想想，那句话说得真是太轻松了。」
en: “Looking back, I said that far too easily.”

zh_CN: 【她吸了吸鼻子。】
en: [She sniffles.]

zh_CN: 「不过……我说话算话。这次我会自己走进手术室。」
en: “But... I keep my promises. This time, I'll walk into the operating room myself.”

zh_CN: 「害怕可以说出来。你不需要装成一点都不怕。」
en: “You can tell us you're scared. You don't have to pretend you're not.”

zh_CN: 「那我先声明！我一定会很怕！也一定会叫！」
en: “Then let me say this now! I'm definitely going to be scared! And I'm definitely going to yell!”

zh_CN: 「哈哈，这个我们已经非常了解啦。」
en: “Haha, we're very familiar with that already.”

zh_CN: 「阿库娅医生！！」
en: “Dr. Aqua!!”

zh_CN: 【气氛终于稍微松弛。坂口说明这次继续采用硬膜外麻醉，通过留置导管持续给药；术中由麻醉人员监护，若麻醉覆盖不足或出现明显内脏牵拉不适，将评估并调整镇痛、必要时启动备用麻醉方案。确认知情同意。具体置管节段、药物和给药参数留待医学审稿。】
en: [The tension finally eases a little. Sakaguchi explains that they will use epidural anesthesia again, with medication administered continuously through an indwelling catheter. Anesthesia staff will monitor her throughout surgery. If coverage is inadequate or significant discomfort from visceral traction occurs, they will assess and adjust analgesia, using a backup anesthesia plan if necessary. Informed consent is confirmed.]
“...All right. I'll sign.”

zh_CN: 【千早休息后，瑞穗在病房走廊叫住坂口。】
en: [After Chihaya settles down to rest, Mizuho stops Sakaguchi in the ward corridor.]

zh_CN: 「坂口医生！等一下，我也有事要拜托你。」
en: “Dr. Sakaguchi! Wait, I have something to ask you, too.”

zh_CN: 「瑞穗小姐？千早怎么了？」
en: “Miss Mizuho? Is something wrong with Chihaya?”

zh_CN: 「不是千早。是我。」
en: “It's not Chihaya. It's me.”

zh_CN: 「我也想在星见开一次刀！」
en: “I want to have an operation at Hoshimi, too!”

zh_CN: 「……你说什么？」
en: “...What did you say?”

zh_CN: 【短暂静默。】
en: [A brief silence.]

zh_CN: 「千早病了，休学一年跟家里很好解释。可是我身体太健康了，家里就说我没有理由陪她留在日本。」
en: “Chihaya's sick, so it's easy to explain taking a year off school to her family. But I'm too healthy, so my family says I have no reason to stay in Japan with her.”

zh_CN: 「那我也做个手术，不就有恢复期了吗？」
en: “If I have an operation too, won't I need time to recover?”

zh_CN: 「你把医院当成什么了……」
en: “What do you think a hospital is for...?”

zh_CN: 「所以我先来找医生嘛！检查一下再决定。」
en: “That's why I came to a doctor first! Examine me, then we'll decide.”

zh_CN: 【转场：诊察室。坂口按申请进行问诊和必要体检；瑞穗没有相关症状，检查结论完全健康。】
en: [Transition: an examination room. At her request, Sakaguchi takes a history and performs the necessary physical examination. Mizuho has no relevant symptoms; the examination finds her completely healthy.]

zh_CN: 「检查结束。你的健康状况很好，没有需要手术治疗的疾病。」
en: “The examination is complete. You're in excellent health. You don't have any illness that requires surgery.”

zh_CN: 「太好了！」
en: “Great!”

zh_CN: 「……你听懂我说什么了吗？」
en: “...Did you understand what I said?”

zh_CN: 「听懂啦！就是说我很健康，可以放心开刀了！」
en: “Of course! You mean I'm healthy, so I can have surgery without worrying!”

zh_CN: 「……完全不是这个意思！」
en: “...That is absolutely not what I meant!”

zh_CN: 【坂口扶住额头，最后决定向院长确认医院是否承接此类自费申请。】
en: [Sakaguchi holds his forehead, then decides to ask the director whether the hospital accepts this kind of self-funded request.]

zh_CN: 【明日香听完说明，并不显得特别惊讶。】
en: [Asuka does not look particularly surprised after hearing the explanation.]

zh_CN: 「健康人主动申请开腹探查……星见可以承接。不过坂口医生，是否由你主刀，要由你自己决定。」
en: “A healthy person voluntarily requesting an exploratory laparotomy... Hoshimi can accommodate that. But Dr. Sakaguchi, whether you perform it is your own decision.”

zh_CN: 「那就好！坂口医生，你答应了吧？」
en: “Wonderful! Dr. Sakaguchi, you'll do it, right?”

zh_CN: 「……我还没答应呢。」
en: “...I haven't agreed yet.”

zh_CN: 「还有，这不是治疗疾病，费用全部自理。」
en: “Also, since this isn't treatment for a disease, you'll be paying all the costs yourself.”

zh_CN: 「知道啦！钱不是问题！」
en: “I know! Money isn't a problem!”

zh_CN: 【明日香报出包含常规麻醉费用的总报价。】
en: [Asuka gives her the total quote, including the usual anesthesia fees.]

zh_CN: 「哦，就这么点？我一个月零花钱也差不多有这么多。」
en: “Oh, is that all? That's about what I get in pocket money each month.”
“...Each month?”

zh_CN: 「坂口医生，你不知道的事情多着呢。」
en: “There are plenty of things you don't know, Dr. Sakaguchi.”

zh_CN: 「不过，如果要开腹，会不会留很明显的疤痕？我还想穿泳装呢。」
en: “But if you open my abdomen, will it leave a very obvious scar? I still want to wear swimsuits.”

zh_CN: 「切口会有痕迹。我们会尽量处理得不明显，但需要时间恢复，别指望拆线当天就看不出来。」
en: “The incision will leave a mark. We'll do what we can to make it less noticeable, but healing takes time. Don't expect it to disappear the day the stitches come out.”

zh_CN: 「那我放心了。」
en: “That's a relief.”

zh_CN: 【她看着费用清单，突然皱眉。】
en: [She looks at the itemized quote and suddenly frowns.]

zh_CN: 「咦，麻醉为什么这么贵？」
en: “Huh? Why is anesthesia so expensive?”

zh_CN: 「这份报价中，麻醉相关费用大约占四成。」
en: “Anesthesia-related expenses account for roughly forty percent of this quote.”

zh_CN: 「四成？！我又不是去睡觉的，居然要花这么多钱！」
en: “Forty percent?! I'm not going there to sleep! Why should that cost so much?”

zh_CN: 「麻醉当然不只是让你睡着——」
en: “Anesthesia does far more than just put you to sleep—”

zh_CN: 「等等。你们这里不是可以选择不麻醉吗？」
en: “Wait. Don't you let people choose to have no anesthesia here?”

zh_CN: 【坂口停顿。】
en: [Sakaguchi pauses.]

zh_CN: 「星见确实有清醒、区域麻醉乃至特殊无麻醉方案。但你要知道，真正开腹的过程和疼痛不是靠逞强就能轻松忍过去的。」
en: “Hoshimi does offer awake surgery, regional anesthesia, and even special plans without anesthesia. But you need to understand: bravado won't make the process and pain of an actual laparotomy easy to endure.”

zh_CN: 「我知道！我要选不麻醉的方案。」
en: “I know! I want the plan without anesthesia.”

zh_CN: 「而且千早都开三次了，我连一次都没经历过。这样以后还怎么笑话她！」
en: “Besides, Chihaya's having three operations, and I haven't had even one. How could I tease her afterward?”

zh_CN: 「……我可以接这台。但术前检查和准备必须照做，手术过程中也要听指示，不能临时胡闹。」
en: “...I can take the case. But all the preoperative examinations and preparations still have to be done. During surgery, you must follow instructions. No sudden antics.”

zh_CN: 「放心吧！我一定比千早配合！」
en: “Don't worry! I'll be much more cooperative than Chihaya!”

zh_CN: 「呵呵。坂口医生，看来你有一位很有决心的患者。」
en: “Hehe. Dr. Sakaguchi, it seems you have a very determined patient.”

zh_CN: 【稍后，办理预约和预付款。坂口向瑞穗说明无麻醉手术的具体范围和风险；她确认申请并签署相关同意文件。明日香按取消麻醉项目后的金额重新出具报价，瑞穗支付这份**无麻醉方案新报价的50%**作为术前预付款。手术定在下周一；本周五正式入院。】
en: [Later, they complete the booking and prepayment. Sakaguchi explains the specific scope and risks of surgery without anesthesia. Mizuho confirms her request and signs the relevant consent forms. Asuka issues a revised quote with the anesthesia items removed, and Mizuho pays fifty percent of this new quote for the plan without anesthesia as her preoperative deposit. Surgery is scheduled for next Monday; formal admission will be this Friday.]

zh_CN: 【瑞穗悄悄靠近坂口，声音放得很低。】
en: [Mizuho quietly moves closer to Sakaguchi, lowering her voice.]

zh_CN: 「那个……坂口医生，我还有最后一个问题。」
en: “Um... Dr. Sakaguchi, I have one last question.”

zh_CN: 「说吧。」
en: “Go ahead.”

zh_CN: 「如果真的很疼，我可以随便大叫吧？不会有人拿什么堵我的嘴吧？」
en: “If it really hurts, I can scream as much as I want, right? Nobody's going to put anything in my mouth to stop me?”

zh_CN: 「当然可以喊。没有人会堵你的嘴。」
en: “Of course you can shout. Nobody will gag you.”
“...Good.”

zh_CN: 【她又迅速恢复灿烂笑容。】
en: [Her bright smile quickly returns.]

zh_CN: 「那么，下周就拜托你啦！」
en: “Then I'm counting on you next week!”

zh_CN: 【背景：千早病房。手术日早晨。】
en: [Background: Chihaya's room. The morning of surgery.]

zh_CN: 【病房护士利根川安琪完成术前交接。千早已经接受必要的术前清洁、肠道准备与备皮。她戴着患者手术帽，表情极度紧张。】
en: [Ward nurse Anji Tonegawa completes the preoperative handover. Chihaya has undergone the necessary cleansing, bowel preparation, and hair removal. She wears a patient's surgical cap and looks extremely nervous.]

zh_CN: 「千早小姐，术前项目已经确认了。接下来去手术室，麻醉监护人员会再次核对方案。坂口医生也在等你。」
en: “Miss Chihaya, we've checked all your preoperative preparations. Next, we'll go to the operating room, where the anesthesia team will confirm the plan again. Dr. Sakaguchi is waiting for you, too.”

zh_CN: 「……第三次做这些事情，也完全不会习惯耶。」
en: “...Even the third time, you don't get used to any of this.”

zh_CN: 「您上次也这么说。」
en: “You said that last time, too.”

zh_CN: 「因为每次都一样可怕嘛！」
en: “Because it's just as scary every time!”

zh_CN: 【瑞穗站在转运床旁，努力摆出鼓励好友的笑容。】
en: [Mizuho stands beside the transfer bed, trying hard to smile encouragingly at her friend.]

zh_CN: 「加油，千早！这次坂口医生主刀，而且真正病因也找到了！」
en: “You can do it, Chihaya! Dr. Sakaguchi is leading this time, and they've found the real cause!”

zh_CN: 「我知道……我知道……」
en: “I know... I know...”

zh_CN: 「下周就轮到我啦！到时候我肯定比你镇定！」
en: “It'll be my turn next week! I'll definitely be calmer than you!”

zh_CN: 「……我求你不要在这种时候说得那么开心好不好！」
en: “...Could you please not sound so happy about it right now?!”

zh_CN: 【转运床停在手术室门口。千早坚持按此前的承诺自己走进去；护士先扶她从转运床起身，确认她站稳。】
en: [The transfer bed stops at the operating room entrance. Chihaya insists on keeping her promise to walk in herself. A nurse helps her up from the bed and makes sure she is steady on her feet.]

zh_CN: 【门内是熟悉的无影灯、手术台和器械车。千早呼吸立刻急促起来。】
en: [Inside are the familiar surgical lights, operating table, and instrument trolley. Chihaya's breathing immediately quickens.]

zh_CN: 「……啊啊，果然还是那个地方。」
en: “...Ahh, it really is that place again.”

zh_CN: 【她下意识向后缩了半步，紧紧抓住身旁的转运床栏杆。护士没有催促，站在一旁等她。】
en: [Instinctively, she retreats half a step and grips the transfer bed's rail. The nurse waits beside her without rushing her.]

zh_CN: 「千早小姐。」
en: “Miss Chihaya.”

zh_CN: 【坂口已换好刷手服与手术帽。】
en: [Sakaguchi has changed into scrubs and a surgical cap.]

zh_CN: 「坂口医生……」
en: “Dr. Sakaguchi...”

zh_CN: 「你上次说，这次由我主刀就不会跑。」
en: “Last time, you said you wouldn't run if I led this operation.”
“...I did.”

zh_CN: 「我就在这里。」
en: “I'm right here.”

zh_CN: 【千早吸了好几口气。她的手指仍攥着栏杆，腿也在发抖。】
en: [Chihaya takes several breaths. Her fingers still clutch the rail, and her legs tremble.]

zh_CN: 「……说话算话。」
en: “...A promise is a promise.”

zh_CN: 【千早一点一点松开栏杆。她迈出第一步，在护士的陪护下亲自跨过手术室门槛。】
en: [Chihaya gradually releases the rail. She takes her first step and crosses the operating room threshold herself, accompanied by a nurse.]

zh_CN: 「……我进来了！」
「我看见了。」
en: “I saw.”

zh_CN: 【千早回头瞟了一眼尚未关闭的手术室门，身体不自觉地向门口偏了偏。】
en: [Chihaya glances back at the still-open door, her body unconsciously leaning toward it.]

zh_CN: 【七濑恋和岩崎留美迎上来，一左一右陪着千早往手术台走。】
en: [Ren Nanase and Rumi Iwasaki come forward, one on either side, accompanying Chihaya to the operating table.]

zh_CN: 「早上好，千早小姐。这次自己走进来了呢。」
en: “Good morning, Miss Chihaya. You walked in yourself this time.”

zh_CN: 「说到做到，很有骨气嘛！」
en: “You kept your word. That takes courage!”

zh_CN: 「……等一下。恋小姐，留美姐姐。」
en: “...Wait a moment. Miss Ren, Rumi.”
“Yes?”

zh_CN: 「你们两个为什么又是一左一右的？这站法……」
en: “Why are you on either side of me again? This formation...”

zh_CN: 「上次把你请回手术室的时候，我们不也是这么走的吗？」
en: “Isn't this how we walked when we brought you back to the operating room last time?”

zh_CN: 「果然是防逃跑阵形啊！！」
en: “It really is the anti-escape formation!!”

zh_CN: 「今天是欢迎你进来的阵形哦。」
en: “Today, it's the welcoming-you-in formation.”

zh_CN: 「对呀。只要你不往门外冲，我们就一直负责欢迎。」
en: “Exactly. As long as you don't charge for the door, we'll keep welcoming you.”

zh_CN: 「……这种欢迎方式一点都不让人安心啦！」
en: “...This kind of welcome isn't reassuring at all!”

zh_CN: 【手术室外的瑞穗最后看了千早一眼。手术室门随后关闭。】
en: [Outside the operating room, Mizuho takes one last look at Chihaya. The doors then close.]

zh_CN: 【背景：手术室。千早在七濑恋与岩崎留美的帮助下坐上手术台，戴着完整遮发的患者手术帽。坂口为主刀，阿库娅为第一助手；七濑恋担任器械护士，岩崎留美担任巡回护士，另有麻醉监护人员负责之后的持续给药。】
en: [Background: the operating room. Ren Nanase and Rumi Iwasaki help Chihaya onto the operating table. Her patient's surgical cap fully covers her hair. Sakaguchi is the lead surgeon, with Aqua as first assistant. Ren Nanase is the scrub nurse, and Rumi Iwasaki the circulating nurse. Anesthesia staff will manage ongoing medication afterward.]

zh_CN: 【留美接好基础监护。坂口穿着刷手服，尚未刷手穿上无菌手术袍。千早一看到准备好的硬膜外穿刺物品，脸色又白了一点。】
en: [Rumi connects the basic monitors. Sakaguchi is in scrubs and has not yet scrubbed in or put on a sterile gown. Chihaya goes a little paler when she sees the prepared epidural equipment.]

zh_CN: 「我怎么觉得比上次准备得还认真……」
en: “Why does it feel like you've prepared even more carefully than last time...?”

zh_CN: 「因为这次要认真检查肠系膜那一边呀。」
en: “Because we need to take a good look at the mesentery this time.”

zh_CN: 「阿库娅医生，拜托你不要用这么兴奋的声音说『检查肠系膜』啦！」
en: “Dr. Aqua, please don't sound so excited when you say ‘look at the mesentery’!”

zh_CN: 「那么，硬膜外就让我来吧。这次我是助手，主刀医生可以省点力气。」
en: “Then let me do the epidural. I'm assisting this time, so our lead surgeon can save some energy.”

zh_CN: 「不要不要！我要坂口医生给我打！」
en: “No, no! I want Dr. Sakaguchi to do it!”

zh_CN: 「哇，你的架子好大呀！现在连打麻醉都要指定主刀医生？」
en: “Wow, aren't you demanding! Now you even want the lead surgeon to give you the anesthetic?”

zh_CN: 「因为……因为我比较喜欢坂口医生帮我打嘛！」
en: “Because... because I prefer Dr. Sakaguchi doing it!”

zh_CN: 【她话一出口，自己也红了脸。】
en: [The moment she says it, she blushes.]

zh_CN: 「好好好。上次也是我做的，这次照旧。」
en: “All right, all right. I did it last time, so we'll do the same again.”

zh_CN: 「……真的？谢谢！」
en: “...Really? Thank you!”

zh_CN: 【七濑恋扶千早转为侧卧，稳住她的肩膀和上身；留美帮助她屈膝、保持双腿的位置，并把遮布放妥。千早下意识护了一下胸前，又拉了拉下身的遮布，红着脸不敢看坂口。】
en: [Ren helps Chihaya turn onto her side, supporting her shoulders and upper body. Rumi helps bend her knees, keeps her legs positioned, and arranges the covering. Chihaya instinctively shields her chest, then tugs at the cloth over her lower body, blushing and unable to look at Sakaguchi.]

zh_CN: 【坂口看了千早一眼，开始准备腰背部消毒。】
en: [Sakaguchi glances at Chihaya and begins preparing to disinfect her lower back.]

zh_CN: 「千早小姐，先保持这个姿势。紧张可以说话，但是背不要突然动。」
en: “Miss Chihaya, hold this position for now. You can talk if you're nervous, but don't move your back suddenly.”

zh_CN: 「腿这边交给我。你只要维持住这个弯曲的姿势就好。」
en: “Leave your legs to me. You just need to keep them bent like this.”

zh_CN: 「……你们又把我夹在中间！这也是防逃跑吧？！」
en: “...You've sandwiched me between you again! Is this to stop me escaping, too?!”

zh_CN: 「这次真的是为了打麻醉。你要是突然伸腿，我们反而更紧张呢。」
en: “This time, it really is for the anesthetic. If you suddenly straighten your legs, we'll be the nervous ones.”

zh_CN: 「我、我知道。每次到这里，都觉得自己一点心理准备都没有……」
en: “I-I know. Every time I get to this point, I feel completely unprepared...”

zh_CN: 「我们慢慢来。先消毒，再做局部麻醉。我告诉你每一步。」
en: “We'll take it slowly. First disinfection, then local anesthetic. I'll explain each step.”

zh_CN: 【坂口按无菌规范完成硬膜外穿刺与导管置入，固定导管并由麻醉监护人员接续评估与给药。七濑恋扶稳千早上身，留美稳住她屈起的双腿。千早虽然紧张，穿刺过程中始终保持姿势。】
en: [Following aseptic procedure, Sakaguchi performs the epidural puncture and inserts and secures the catheter. Anesthesia staff take over assessment and medication. Ren steadies Chihaya's upper body while Rumi supports her bent legs. Though nervous, Chihaya holds her position throughout the puncture.]

zh_CN: 「……呼。结束了？」
en: “...Phew. Is it over?”

zh_CN: 「置管完成。还要确认麻醉起效的范围。」
en: “The catheter is in. We still need to check the extent of the anesthesia.”

zh_CN: 「都第三次了，我怎么还是觉得从背后打麻醉特别奇怪……多少次都习惯不了。」
en: “This is the third time, and getting anesthetic from behind still feels so strange... I could never get used to it.”

zh_CN: 「这次真的比上次配合得好多了。照这个速度，下次我连提醒都不用提醒了！」
en: “You really were much more cooperative than last time. At this rate, next time I won't even need to remind you!”

zh_CN: 「不要随口给我安排第四次手术啊！！」
en: “Don't casually schedule a fourth operation for me!!”

zh_CN: 「哈哈哈！这点我倒是完全同意千早。」
en: “Hahaha! I completely agree with Chihaya on that one.”

zh_CN: 【千早重新仰卧。留美与麻醉监护人员核对生命体征和麻醉平面，七濑恋协助完成感觉测试。硬膜外镇痛逐渐起效，千早试着挪动双腿，却发现腿部明显发沉。】
en: [Chihaya lies on her back again. Rumi and the anesthesia staff check her vital signs and block level, with Ren assisting in sensory testing. As the epidural analgesia takes effect, Chihaya tries to move her legs and finds them distinctly heavy.]

zh_CN: 「……咦？等一下，我的腿怎么这么沉？」
en: “...Huh? Wait, why are my legs so heavy?”

zh_CN: 「麻醉开始起效了。跟上次一样，接下来我们会继续检查范围。」
en: “The anesthetic is starting to work. Just like last time, we'll keep checking its coverage.”

zh_CN: 「我、我知道……可是这样不就更跑不掉了吗？！」
en: “I-I know... But doesn't that make it even harder to escape?!”

zh_CN: 「有不舒服的地方就告诉我们。现在可以安心做后面的准备了。」
en: “Tell us if anything feels uncomfortable. We can move on with the preparations now.”

zh_CN: 「这次你已经自己走进来了，接下来交给我们就好。」
en: “You already walked in yourself this time. Leave the rest to us.”

zh_CN: 「我本来就没打算再跑！可是你们一说『安心』，我反而更慌了啦！」
en: “I wasn't planning to run again! But the more you tell me to relax, the more I panic!”

zh_CN: 【留美按流程完成导尿、体位保护、腹部皮肤消毒等术前准备。七濑恋刷手后穿好无菌袍，在无菌台清点器械。坂口与阿库娅也依次完成刷手和无菌着装，团队铺好无菌洞巾。】
en: [Rumi carries out urinary catheterization, positioning protection, abdominal skin disinfection, and the remaining preoperative preparations. After scrubbing in, Ren puts on a sterile gown and counts the instruments at the sterile table. Sakaguchi and Aqua scrub in and don sterile attire in turn, and the team places the sterile fenestrated drapes.]

zh_CN: 「你们忙来忙去，我突然觉得刚才那针都不算什么了……」
en: “With all of you rushing around, that needle suddenly feels like nothing...”

zh_CN: 「监护这边我一直看着呢。哪里不舒服，你马上说。」
en: “I'm watching the monitors the whole time. Tell me right away if anything feels uncomfortable.”

zh_CN: 「千早小姐，麻醉测试已经完成。切口区域的疼痛应该得到充分控制；如果过程中出现不适，要立刻告诉我们。」
en: “Miss Chihaya, we've finished testing the anesthesia. Pain in the incision area should be well controlled. If you feel discomfort during the procedure, tell us immediately.”

zh_CN: 「……我还醒着。」
en: “...I'm still awake.”

zh_CN: 「嗯，我们说好会让你保持清醒。麻醉人员会一直监护，硬膜外导管也能持续调整镇痛。」
en: “Yes, as we agreed. The anesthesia staff will monitor you continuously, and analgesia can be adjusted through the epidural catheter.”

zh_CN: 「那么我能不能申请别让我看见刀？」
en: “Then can I request not to see the knife?”

zh_CN: 「你可以看着我或者手术室天花板，不需要一直盯着术野。」
en: “You can look at me or the operating room ceiling. You don't need to keep watching the operative field.”
“...Okay!”

zh_CN: 【团队完成手术暂停核对（timeout），确认患者、术式、体位、麻醉状态与器械计数。】
en: [The team completes the surgical timeout, confirming the patient, procedure, position, anesthesia status, and instrument count.]

zh_CN: 「开始。」
en: “Let's begin.”

zh_CN: 「手术刀。」
en: “Scalpel.”

zh_CN: 【七濑恋递出手术刀。坂口切开皮肤，逐层进入腹腔。千早听见器械交接声，立刻紧张地闭紧眼睛。】
en: [Ren passes the scalpel. Sakaguchi incises the skin and enters the abdominal cavity layer by layer. At the sound of instruments changing hands, Chihaya nervously squeezes her eyes shut.]

zh_CN: 「……已经开始了吗？」
en: “...Have you started?”

zh_CN: 「开始了。你配合得很好。」
en: “We have. You're doing very well.”

zh_CN: 「呜……为什么我一点都不觉得这是值得表扬的事……」
en: “Ugh... Why doesn't that feel like something worth praising...?”

zh_CN: 【手术进行一段时间后。留美注意到手术室门口来了另一位医师。】
en: [Some time into the operation, Rumi notices another physician at the operating room entrance.]

zh_CN: 【御園芹香穿着刷手服、戴着手术帽与系带口罩，来到非无菌区域的影像屏幕旁。】
en: [Serika Misono, wearing scrubs, a surgical cap, and a tie-on mask, approaches the imaging screen in the nonsterile area.]

zh_CN: 「……御園医生？」
en: “...Dr. Misono?”

zh_CN: 「影像上的判断终究只是判断。我想确认一下实际解剖是不是和影像一致。」
en: “An imaging assessment is still only an assessment. I wanted to see whether the actual anatomy matches.”

zh_CN: 「你愿意过来，我很感谢。屏幕上已经调出术前影像。」
en: “I'm grateful you came. The preoperative scans are already on the screen.”

zh_CN: 「这位就是帮我们找到线索的御園医生。」
en: “This is Dr. Misono, who helped us find the clue.”

zh_CN: 【千早偏头看向芹香。口罩上方那双冷静的眼睛让她不由自主地缩了一下。】
en: [Chihaya turns toward Serika. The calm eyes above her mask make Chihaya shrink back involuntarily.]

zh_CN: 「……坂口医生，这位医生姐姐看起来有点吓人……」
en: “...Dr. Sakaguchi, this doctor looks a little scary...”

zh_CN: 「听得见。」
en: “I can hear you.”

zh_CN: 「对、对不起！！」
en: “S-Sorry!!”

zh_CN: 「不用道歉。先听坂口医生的指示。」
en: “No need to apologize. Listen to Dr. Sakaguchi's instructions.”

zh_CN: 【芹香转向屏幕，仔细对照影像与术中暴露的结构。】
en: [Serika turns to the screen, carefully comparing the images with the structures exposed during surgery.]

zh_CN: 【手术团队先确认盆腔情况。阿库娅从妇科角度再次观察子宫与双侧附件；相关结构与前次记录一致，没有新的妇科异常。】
en: [The surgical team first checks the pelvis. Aqua reassesses the uterus and both adnexa from a gynecological perspective. The structures match the previous records, with no new gynecological abnormalities.]

zh_CN: 「子宫、卵巢还是很健康。问题不在这里。」
en: “The uterus and ovaries are still healthy. The problem isn't here.”

zh_CN: 「同意。注意这部分囊性组织的走向。」
en: “Agreed. Notice the direction of this cystic tissue.”

zh_CN: 【进一步探查发现，盆腔内的囊性组织并非孤立的一团。阿库娅协助轻轻移开覆盖其上的小肠，白色半透明的囊壁沿着组织间隙向上延伸，进入小肠系膜之间。】
en: [Further exploration reveals that the cystic tissue in the pelvis is not an isolated mass. Aqua gently helps move aside the small bowel covering it. The white, translucent cyst wall extends upward along tissue planes into the small-bowel mesentery.]

zh_CN: 「可以确认一下这条血管分支和病灶的相对位置吗？」
en: “Could you check the relative positions of this vascular branch and the lesion?”

zh_CN: 「这条？」
en: “This one?”

zh_CN: 「对。它与第三组影像中的移位方向一致。如果病灶只是盆腔内的独立囊肿，就不该有这样的连续关系。」
en: “Yes. Its displacement matches the third set of images. An isolated pelvic cyst shouldn't have this kind of continuity.”

zh_CN: 【坂口重新调整观察角度，请阿库娅维持视野，沿囊壁仔细向肠系膜一侧追踪。】
en: [Sakaguchi adjusts his viewing angle, asks Aqua to maintain exposure, and carefully follows the cyst wall toward the mesentery.]

zh_CN: 「……确实。病灶不是从盆腔长上来的，是沿着肠系膜向下延伸。」
en: “...You're right. The lesion didn't grow upward from the pelvis. It extends downward along the mesentery.”

zh_CN: 「那么前两次处理的部分，的确可能是它末端最显眼的那一段。」
en: “Then the parts treated in the first two operations really may have been the most conspicuous portion at its tip.”

zh_CN: 【再向上显露一点，坂口停下动作。一条供应邻近小肠的血管分支紧贴着囊壁的外缘，囊壁与正常肠系膜组织的界线在这里变得很窄。】
en: [After exposing a little more above, Sakaguchi stops. A vascular branch supplying the adjacent small bowel lies close against the cyst wall's outer edge. Here, the boundary between the cyst wall and normal mesenteric tissue becomes very narrow.]

zh_CN: 「血管离得这么近……如果只是从盆腔这一端截断，倒会容易得多。」
en: “The vessel is so close... Simply dividing it at the pelvic end would be much easier.”

zh_CN: 「但那样只取掉向下突出的部分。前两次没有看见的这一段，还会留在肠系膜里。」
en: “But that would only remove the part projecting downward. This section, which we didn't see in the first two operations, would remain in the mesentery.”

zh_CN: 【坂口停下分离动作，先查看邻近肠管与血管的关系。】
en: [Sakaguchi pauses the dissection to examine the relationship between the adjacent bowel and vessels.]

zh_CN: 「御園医生，影像上能确定这条血管是穿过病灶，还是被它推向一旁吗？」
en: “Dr. Misono, can the images establish whether this vessel passes through the lesion or is pushed aside by it?”

zh_CN: 「更像是受到挤压、向外侧移位。但有没有足够的分离层，影像不能替你们判断。」
en: “It looks more like compression with lateral displacement. But imaging can't tell you whether there's an adequate dissection plane.”

zh_CN: 【千早听见“血管”和“分离层”，刚才努力保持平稳的呼吸一下又乱了。】
en: [Hearing ‘vessel’ and ‘dissection plane,’ Chihaya loses the steady breathing she had worked so hard to maintain.]

zh_CN: 「……血管？你们说的是我的血管吗？！」
en: “...A vessel? Are you talking about my blood vessels?!”

zh_CN: 「监护数据还很稳定。千早小姐，先别憋气，有哪里不舒服就说。」
en: “Your monitor readings are still stable. Miss Chihaya, don't hold your breath. Tell us if anything feels uncomfortable.”

zh_CN: 「连护士姐姐都突然这么认真……我更害怕了啦！」
en: “Even the nurse suddenly sounds so serious... Now I'm even more scared!”

zh_CN: 「等、等一下！什么叫分离层？你们不会连我的肠子都要切掉吧？！」
en: “W-Wait! What's a dissection plane? You're not going to cut out my intestines, too?!”

zh_CN: 【阿库娅保持牵开，抬头看了千早一眼。】
en: [Keeping the retraction steady, Aqua glances up at Chihaya.]

zh_CN: 「我们正在确认病灶和正常肠管能不能安全分开。我看清楚以后会告诉你。」
en: “We're checking whether the lesion can be safely separated from the normal bowel. I'll tell you once I can see clearly.”

zh_CN: 「……呜。明明感觉不到刀，我还是快吓死了……」
en: “...Ugh. I can't even feel the knife, but I'm still scared to death...”

zh_CN: 「我知道。你先听坂口医生的声音，我们不会跳过确认的。」
en: “I know. Listen to Dr. Sakaguchi's voice for now. We won't skip that check.”

zh_CN: 「明白。阿库娅，先帮我维持这里的视野。」
en: “Understood. Aqua, help me maintain the view here.”

zh_CN: 【阿库娅调整牵开方向。坂口仔细辨认囊壁外缘，在贴近血管的位置找到一层薄薄的正常组织间隙；再确认邻近肠壁没有被病灶侵犯。】
en: [Aqua adjusts the direction of retraction. Carefully identifying the cyst wall's outer edge, Sakaguchi finds a thin plane of normal tissue near the vessel, then confirms that the lesion has not invaded the adjacent bowel wall.]

zh_CN: 「……看得见分离层。肠壁也没有连进去。」
en: “...I can see the dissection plane. The bowel wall isn't involved, either.”

zh_CN: 「血管在分离层外，供血能够保住。这样就不用为了切除病灶，连那段正常的小肠一起切掉。」
en: “The vessel is outside the plane, and we can preserve the blood supply. That means we won't need to remove that healthy section of small bowel along with the lesion.”

zh_CN: 「……不用切我的肠子了？！」
en: “...You don't have to cut out my intestines?!”

zh_CN: 「确认了。肠管本身没有受累，我们可以把它保留下来。」
en: “Confirmed. The bowel itself isn't involved. We can preserve it.”

zh_CN: 「我刚才真的以为……啊啊，吓死我了……」
en: “I really thought... Ahh, that scared me so much...”

zh_CN: 【千早的声音仍在抖，却终于能慢慢吐出一口气。留美确认监护平稳，向坂口点头。】
en: [Chihaya's voice still trembles, but she finally manages a slow exhale. Rumi confirms the monitors are stable and nods to Sakaguchi.]

zh_CN: 【坂口重新确认术野，明确了切除范围。】
en: [Sakaguchi checks the operative field again and defines the extent of resection.]

zh_CN: 「我们沿这层正常组织，把肠系膜内相连的囊性病灶和向盆腔延伸的部分完整取出来。不能再只留下一个看起来干净的盆腔切缘。」
en: “We'll follow this normal tissue plane and remove the connected mesenteric cystic lesion and its pelvic extension in full. We can't settle for another pelvic margin that merely looks clear.”

zh_CN: 「明白。这次终于能追到另一端了。」
en: “Understood. This time, we can finally trace it to the other end.”

zh_CN: 「七濑，分离剪。」
en: “Nanase, dissecting scissors.”

zh_CN: 「分离剪。」
en: “Dissecting scissors.”

zh_CN: 「……剪刀？！你们现在又要剪哪里啊？！」
en: “...Scissors?! What are you cutting now?!”

zh_CN: 「沿刚确认的层次分离病灶。医生要用合适的器械，我得确认递对才行呀。」
en: “Separating the lesion along the plane we just confirmed. The doctor needs the appropriate instrument, and I have to make sure I pass the right one.”

zh_CN: 「我知道啦！可我听着还是很可怕耶！」
en: “I know! But it still sounds terrifying!”

zh_CN: 【七濑恋递上分离剪。阿库娅稳定显露，坂口沿着确认过的分离层逐段处理，将囊壁与肠系膜内的正常血管分开，并处理相连的细小淋巴管分支。】
en: [Ren passes the dissecting scissors. Aqua maintains steady exposure as Sakaguchi works section by section along the confirmed plane, separating the cyst wall from normal mesenteric vessels and dealing with the small connected lymphatic branches.]

zh_CN: 【靠近那条血管时，坂口再次停下，重新确认两者间的界限；阿库娅轻轻改变牵引方向，让最窄的一段显露出来。】
en: [Near that vessel, Sakaguchi pauses again to recheck the boundary. Aqua gently changes the direction of traction to expose the narrowest section.]

zh_CN: 【千早听着医师们讨论血管，呼吸再次急促起来。留美查看监护，稍稍靠近她。】
en: [Listening to the doctors discuss vessels, Chihaya starts breathing rapidly again. Rumi checks the monitors and moves a little closer.]

zh_CN: 「千早小姐，呼吸有点快。是疼，还是听他们说话吓到了？」
en: “Miss Chihaya, you're breathing a bit fast. Does it hurt, or did hearing them frighten you?”

zh_CN: 「……听见血管两个字就吓人！」
en: “...Just hearing ‘blood vessel’ is scary!”

zh_CN: 「明白。现在数据还平稳。你慢慢呼气，要是有疼痛或明显牵拉就马上告诉我。」
en: “Understood. Your readings are still stable. Breathe out slowly, and tell me right away if you feel pain or significant pulling.”

zh_CN: 「……我知道啦。你别离开哦。」
en: “...Okay. Don't leave me.”

zh_CN: 「我一直在这里看着呢。」
en: “I'm right here watching the whole time.”

zh_CN: 「……分开了。血管没受伤。」
en: “...It's separated. The vessel is intact.”

zh_CN: 「很好。继续保持视野。」
en: “Good. Keep maintaining exposure.”

zh_CN: 【千早一直不敢插话，直到听见“没受伤”，才小声开口。】
en: [Chihaya has been afraid to interrupt. Only after hearing ‘intact’ does she speak quietly.]

zh_CN: 「……是那个血管没受伤，对吧？」
en: “...You mean that blood vessel wasn't hurt, right?”

zh_CN: 「对。坂口医生正在把最麻烦的部分处理掉。」
en: “Right. Dr. Sakaguchi is taking care of the most difficult part.”

zh_CN: 「那、那你们继续！我不吵了……」
en: “Th-Then carry on! I'll be quiet...”

zh_CN: 【经过一段细致的处理，连向盆腔的囊性组织与其肠系膜内的来源部分终于作为完整标本被取出，放入无菌标本盘。】
en: [After a period of meticulous work, the cystic tissue extending into the pelvis and its mesenteric origin are finally removed as one complete specimen and placed in a sterile specimen tray.]

zh_CN: 【坂口与阿库娅检查处理后的组织间隙，确认没有肉眼可见的囊壁残留；邻近肠管颜色与血供情况正常，主要血管分支完好。】
en: [Sakaguchi and Aqua inspect the treated tissue planes, confirming that no cyst wall remains visible. The adjacent bowel has normal color and blood supply, and the major vascular branches are intact.]

zh_CN: 「标本送病理。接下来再检查一遍止血和肠管状态。」
en: “Send the specimen to pathology. Next, we'll check hemostasis and the bowel once more.”

zh_CN: 【千早听见“标本送病理”，紧张地向坂口确认。】
en: [Hearing ‘send the specimen to pathology,’ Chihaya anxiously asks Sakaguchi for confirmation.]

zh_CN: 「……找到了吗？那个一直害我开刀的东西？」
en: “...Did you find it? The thing that kept making me need surgery?”

zh_CN: 「找到了。这次不只是拿掉盆腔里的那部分，我们把它在肠系膜里相连的来源也一起处理了。」
en: “We found it. This time, we didn't just remove the pelvic portion. We treated its connected source in the mesentery, too.”
“...Really?”

zh_CN: 「真的。而且小肠、子宫和卵巢都好好的。」
en: “Really. And your small bowel, uterus, and ovaries are all fine.”

zh_CN: 「太好了……」
en: “Thank goodness...”

zh_CN: 【芹香又观察一会儿，确认了影像与实际结构的对应。】
en: [Serika observes a little longer, confirming how the images correspond to the actual structures.]

zh_CN: 「……和影像判断一致。那我先回去了。」
en: “...It matches the imaging assessment. I'll head back now.”

zh_CN: 【她向坂口略一点头，准备离开。】
en: [She gives Sakaguchi a slight nod and prepares to leave.]

zh_CN: 「医、医生姐姐！等一下！」
en: “D-Doctor! Wait!”

zh_CN: 【芹香停下脚步。】
en: [Serika stops.]

zh_CN: 「刚才说你吓人，对不起……我没想到你真的这么厉害。」
en: “I'm sorry I called you scary earlier... I didn't realize you were really this amazing.”

zh_CN: 「没关系。」
en: “It's all right.”

zh_CN: 「我听你们说了半天，好多都听不懂……不过我知道，你真的帮了大忙！」
en: “I didn't understand a lot of what you were all saying... But I know you helped so much!”

zh_CN: 「……这是医生应该做的。」
en: “...It's what a doctor should do.”

zh_CN: 「那个……如果不妨碍工作，可以先别走吗？」
en: “Um... If it won't interfere with your work, could you stay a little longer?”

zh_CN: 【芹香微微一怔。】
en: [Serika looks slightly taken aback.]

zh_CN: 「坂口医生他们还在我肚子里忙来忙去。我一个人躺着，实在太紧张了……」
en: “Dr. Sakaguchi and the others are still busy inside my tummy. Lying here on my own makes me so nervous...”

zh_CN: 【芹香看向坂口。坂口正专注于术野。】
en: [Serika looks at Sakaguchi, who is concentrating on the operative field.]

zh_CN: 「……不会妨碍。」
en: “...It won't interfere.”

zh_CN: 【她主动走到患者头侧的非无菌区域，停在千早可以轻松看见的位置。】
en: [She moves to the nonsterile area beside the patient's head, stopping where Chihaya can easily see her.]

zh_CN: 「我就在这里。」
en: “I'll be right here.”
“...Thank you!”

zh_CN: 【芹香注意到千早的眼睛总是往无影灯下的器械方向瞟。】
en: [Serika notices Chihaya's eyes repeatedly straying toward the instruments beneath the surgical lights.]

zh_CN: 「一直看着那边，只会更紧张。要不要聊点别的？」
en: “Watching that will only make you more nervous. Shall we talk about something else?”

zh_CN: 「好啊！聊什么都行！只要别聊我肚子里正在做什么！」
en: “Yes! Anything! As long as it's not what's happening inside my tummy!”

zh_CN: 「听坂口医生说，你以前是长曲棍球部的主将？」
en: “Dr. Sakaguchi said you used to captain your lacrosse club?”

zh_CN: 「咦？你知道呀！」
en: “Huh? You knew?”

zh_CN: 「看过你的病史记录。你读的是女子高中？」
en: “I read your medical history. You went to a girls' high school?”

zh_CN: 「对！以前每天训练到很晚呢。虽然校规很严，不过大家感情很好！」
en: “Yes! We used to practice late every day. The rules were strict, but everyone was really close!”

zh_CN: 「我以前读的也是女子高中。比较传统的那种。」
en: “I went to a girls' high school, too. A rather traditional one.”

zh_CN: 「……咦？！医生姐姐也是女校出身？！」
en: “...Huh?! You went to an all-girls school, too?!”

zh_CN: 「有这么奇怪吗？」
en: “Is that so surprising?”

zh_CN: 「没有没有！难怪我总觉得你很像我们学校的学姐！」
en: “No, no! No wonder you keep reminding me of the older girls at our school!”

zh_CN: 「……刚才不是还说我很吓人吗？」
en: “...Didn't you just say I was scary?”

zh_CN: 「我们学校那些特别厉害的学姐，本来也有一点吓人嘛！」
en: “The really impressive older girls at our school were a little scary, too!”

zh_CN: 「……那我就当你在夸奖我。」
en: “...Then I'll take that as a compliment.”

zh_CN: 「说起来，我们学校以前和你们学校有过校际交流。」
en: “Come to think of it, our school used to have exchanges with yours.”

zh_CN: 「咦？！我们学校每年也有社团交流！长曲棍球部还参加过呢！」
en: “Really?! We had club exchanges every year! The lacrosse club took part, too!”

zh_CN: 「那应该不是同一届。我比你早毕业好几年。」
en: “It probably wasn't the same year. I graduated several years before you.”

zh_CN: 「太可惜了！说不定以前还有机会见到学姐时代的芹香医生呢！」
en: “What a shame! Maybe I could have met you back when you were one of the older students, Dr. Serika!”

zh_CN: 「……我们班主任倒是经常提起你们学校。」
en: “...Our homeroom teacher often mentioned your school.”

zh_CN: 「她怎么说？」
en: “What did she say?”

zh_CN: 「『礼仪很周到，但只要开始社团活动，就很难安静下来。』」
en: “‘Very well-mannered, but once club activities begin, it's difficult to get them to quiet down.’”

zh_CN: 「哈哈！那一定是在说我们长曲棍球部！」
en: “Haha! She must have meant our lacrosse club!”

zh_CN: 「交流活动前，她还提醒我们，不要被你们带着违反校规。」
en: “Before exchanges, she warned us not to let you lead us into breaking school rules.”

zh_CN: 「什么嘛！我们老师也会提醒大家，去别的学校千万不要惹风纪委员生气！」
en: “Hey! Our teachers reminded us not to upset the discipline committee when we visited other schools!”

zh_CN: 「……看来双方老师的担心都差不多。」
en: “...It seems the teachers on both sides had similar concerns.”

zh_CN: 「明明两边校规都那么严，还要互相提醒！」
en: “Both schools were so strict, and they still had to warn us about each other!”

zh_CN: 「不过一到比赛和文化祭，大家又会认真帮忙。那种交流其实挺好的。」
en: “But everyone helped earnestly with competitions and cultural festivals. Those exchanges were actually quite nice.”

zh_CN: 「对对！有时候跟别的学校的社团一起准备活动，比上课还有意思！」
en: “Exactly! Sometimes preparing events with clubs from other schools was more interesting than class!”

zh_CN: 【术野旁，坂口与阿库娅完成最后的止血及肠管检查。七濑恋在无菌台备好缝合器械和材料。】
en: [At the operative field, Sakaguchi and Aqua finish their final hemostasis and bowel checks. Ren prepares the suturing instruments and materials on the sterile table.]

zh_CN: 【千早笑了，原本紧绷的肩膀稍稍放松。】
en: [Chihaya laughs, and her tense shoulders relax a little.]

zh_CN: 「你们学校校规也很严吗？我们连袜子的长度都有人检查！」
en: “Were your school rules strict, too? They even checked our sock length!”

zh_CN: 「很严。领结、发饰，连放学以后能在校舍里待多久都有规定。」
en: “Very. Ribbons, hair accessories... There were even rules about how long we could stay in the building after school.”

zh_CN: 「啊——这个我懂！我们社团训练一拖晚，值班老师就拿着钥匙来催人！」
en: “Ahh, I know that one! When practice ran late, the teacher on duty came with the keys to hurry us out!”

zh_CN: 「我们也是。不过有时候老师嘴上说再给十分钟，半小时以后才回来。」
en: “Ours did, too. But sometimes they'd say ten more minutes and not come back for half an hour.”

zh_CN: 「哈哈！就是这种！明明平时那么严格，到了文化祭前又会睁一只眼闭一只眼。」
en: “Haha! Exactly! So strict normally, but just before the cultural festival, they'd turn a blind eye.”

zh_CN: 「嗯。那几天走廊里堆满纸板，旧校舍的灯总是很晚才熄。」
en: “Yes. The corridors were piled with cardboard those days, and the old school building's lights stayed on late.”

zh_CN: 「对对！还有练习结束以后，大家一起去便利店买东西！现在想想，真怀念啊……」
en: “Yes, yes! And we'd all stop at the convenience store after practice! Thinking about it now, I really miss it...”

zh_CN: 【芹香轻轻点头。】
en: [Serika nods gently.]

zh_CN: 「说起来，我还以为医生姐姐以前一定是学生会或者风纪委员呢！」
en: “You know, I was sure you must have been on the student council or discipline committee!”

zh_CN: 「为什么？」
en: “Why?”

zh_CN: 「因为你刚才在手术室里的气势啊！」
en: “Because of the presence you had in the operating room earlier!”
“...You guessed wrong.”

zh_CN: 「芹香医生呢？以前参加什么社团？」
en: “What about you, Dr. Serika? Which club were you in?”

zh_CN: 「轻音部。」
en: “The light music club.”

zh_CN: 「朋友组乐队，正好缺一个弹贝斯的人。我就加入了。」
en: “My friends formed a band and happened to need a bassist. So I joined.”

zh_CN: 「等、等一下！医生姐姐以前居然是轻音少女啊？！」
en: “W-Wait! You were actually a K-On! girl?!”

zh_CN: 【口罩上方，芹香的眼神明显柔和了一些。】
en: [Above her mask, Serika's eyes noticeably soften.]

zh_CN: 「……只是学校的社团。不过，确实练习过《轻音少女》的曲子。」
en: “...It was just a school club. Though we did practice songs from K-On!.”

zh_CN: 「哇！！姐姐会弹《Don't Say Lazy》吗？我超喜欢《轻音少女》的歌！！」
en: “Wow!! Can you play ‘Don't Say Lazy’? I love the songs from K-On! so much!!”

zh_CN: 「会呀。这首歌表演的时候很受欢迎呢。」
en: “Yes. That one was very popular at our performances.”

zh_CN: 「太酷了！！《Cagayake!GIRLS》呢？」
en: “So cool!! What about ‘Cagayake!GIRLS’?”

zh_CN: 「这首歌也排过哦，比《Don't Say Lazy》难呢。」
en: “We rehearsed that one, too. It's harder than ‘Don't Say Lazy.’”

zh_CN: 「姐姐你好厉害！！那你们在哪里表演？像文化祭那种吗？」
en: “You're amazing!! Where did you perform? At cultural festivals and things?”

zh_CN: 「是啊。第一次上台的时候很紧张。」
en: “Yes. I was very nervous the first time we went onstage.”

zh_CN: 「哇！真的啊！我还以为芹香医生什么都不会怕！」
en: “Wow! Really? I thought nothing could scare you, Dr. Serika!”

zh_CN: 「当然会怕。聚光灯一亮，手指都会僵住。不过鼓点一响，真正开始弹以后，反而慢慢镇定下来了。」
en: “Of course I got scared. When the spotlights came on, my fingers would freeze. But once the drums started and I began playing, I gradually calmed down.”

zh_CN: 【坂口与阿库娅开始逐层关闭切口，七濑恋依次递上缝合器械和缝线。】
en: [Sakaguchi and Aqua begin closing the incision layer by layer, while Ren passes the suturing instruments and sutures in sequence.]

zh_CN: 「好帅——！那跟做手术是不是也有点像？」
en: “That's so cool! Is it a little like doing surgery?”

zh_CN: 「……不太一样。」
en: “...Not quite.”

zh_CN: 「哪里不一样？」
en: “How is it different?”

zh_CN: 「舞台上开始弹以后，会渐渐忘记紧张。手术台边却是越接近下刀，越清醒。」
en: “Onstage, once you start playing, you gradually forget your nerves. At the operating table, the closer you get to making the incision, the more acutely aware you become.”

zh_CN: 【芹香看向器械台，语速慢了下来。】
en: [Serika looks toward the instrument table, her speech slowing.]

zh_CN: 「尤其是器械护士把刀柄递到手里的时候……」
en: “Especially when the scrub nurse places the scalpel handle in your hand...”

zh_CN: 【她忽然停住。】
en: [She suddenly stops.]

zh_CN: 【坂口正在操作。他听见这句话，短暂抬起头。两人的视线在无影灯下相遇。】
en: [Sakaguchi is working. Hearing those words, he briefly looks up. Their eyes meet beneath the surgical lights.]

zh_CN: 【芹香迎上坂口的视线，眼神一下收紧。】
en: [Serika meets his gaze, her eyes suddenly tensing.]

zh_CN: 【坂口收回视线，继续处理术野。】
en: [Sakaguchi looks back down and continues working on the operative field.]

zh_CN: 「器械护士，下一把。」
en: “Scrub nurse, the next instrument.”

zh_CN: 【芹香转向千早。】
en: [Serika turns to Chihaya.]

zh_CN: 「……后来我们文化祭演得还不错。」
en: “...Our cultural festival performance went quite well in the end.”

zh_CN: 「真的吗？那你现在还弹贝斯吗？」
en: “Really? Do you still play bass?”

zh_CN: 「已经很久没碰了。」
en: “I haven't touched one in a long time.”

zh_CN: 「那等我出院，能不能听你弹一次？」
en: “Then, after I'm discharged, could I hear you play once?”

zh_CN: 「……先把身体养好再说。」
en: “...Focus on getting better first.”

zh_CN: 「嘿嘿！那我就当你没有拒绝啦！」
en: “Hehe! I'll take that as not saying no!”

zh_CN: 【坂口与阿库娅继续关腹。七濑恋配合递送缝合器械；留美核对记录、持续监护，麻醉人员继续管理硬膜外镇痛。芹香留在千早头侧。】
en: [Sakaguchi and Aqua continue closing the abdomen. Ren passes the suturing instruments, while Rumi checks records and maintains monitoring. Anesthesia staff continue managing epidural analgesia. Serika stays beside Chihaya's head.]

zh_CN: 「等、等等！你们刚才是不是又说『牵开一点』？！」
en: “W-Wait! Did you just say ‘retract a little more’ again?!”

zh_CN: 「是在调整视野。不要怕，情况很好。」
en: “We're adjusting the view. Don't worry. Everything looks good.”

zh_CN: 「你们的『很好』跟我的『很好』根本不是一个意思啊！」
en: “Your ‘good’ and my ‘good’ don't mean the same thing at all!”

zh_CN: 「哈哈，说得也是。」
en: “Haha, fair enough.”

zh_CN: 【坂口与阿库娅完成深层缝合，继续处理最后的皮肤缝合。】
en: [Sakaguchi and Aqua finish the deep sutures and move on to the final skin closure.]

zh_CN: 「处理完成。千早小姐，真正的来源已经找到了，也按术前计划处理好了。」
en: “The treatment is complete. Miss Chihaya, we've found the true source and dealt with it according to the preoperative plan.”

zh_CN: 「……结束了吗？」
en: “...Is it over?”

zh_CN: 「还在做最后的缝合。很快就能回病房。」
en: “We're finishing the last sutures. You'll be back in your room soon.”

zh_CN: 「……呜……真的太好了……」
en: “...Oh... Thank goodness...”

zh_CN: 「辛苦了。」
en: “You've been through a lot.”

zh_CN: 「芹香医生，谢谢你一直陪着我……」
en: “Dr. Serika, thank you for staying with me...”

zh_CN: 「不用勉强说话。先休息。」
en: “Don't force yourself to talk. Rest.”

zh_CN: 【七濑恋与留美共同核对器械、针具与敷料。】
en: [Ren and Rumi jointly check the instruments, needles, and dressings.]

zh_CN: 「器械、针具、敷料，清点一致。」
en: “Instruments, needles, dressings—all counts correct.”

zh_CN: 「双人核对无误。千早小姐状态稳定，术后转运可以准备了。」
en: “Double-check confirmed. Miss Chihaya is stable. We can prepare for postoperative transfer.”

zh_CN: 「……终于听到『可以转运』了！我还以为你们只会说『下一把』呢！」
en: “...Finally, ‘ready for transfer’! I thought all you could say was ‘next instrument’!”

zh_CN: 「呵呵，今天真的辛苦啦。你这次可是从进门到结束都很争气呢。」
en: “Hehe, you really have been through a lot today. You did wonderfully from the moment you came in until the very end.”

zh_CN: 【坂口完成最后确认，千早在监护下转往术后恢复区域。】
en: [Sakaguchi completes the final checks, and Chihaya is transferred under monitoring to the postoperative recovery area.]

zh_CN: 【手术室外。芹香准备离开，坂口向她点头。】
en: [Outside the operating room. As Serika prepares to leave, Sakaguchi nods to her.]

zh_CN: 「今天谢谢你。」
en: “Thank you for today.”

zh_CN: 「……确认判断而已。」
en: “...I was only confirming my assessment.”

zh_CN: 「还有陪千早的事。」
en: “And for keeping Chihaya company.”

zh_CN: 【芹香沉默半秒。】
en: [Serika falls silent for half a second.]

zh_CN: 「她很害怕。」
en: “She was frightened.”

zh_CN: 【芹香转身离开。】
en: [Serika turns and leaves.]

zh_CN: 【背景：千早病房。手术次日上午。】
en: [Background: Chihaya's room. The morning after surgery.]

zh_CN: 【坂口与阿库娅推门而入。千早醒着，脸色比前一天好些，但动作仍很小心。】
en: [Sakaguchi and Aqua enter. Chihaya is awake and looks better than the day before, though she still moves very carefully.]

zh_CN: 「坂口医生！阿库娅医生！」
en: “Dr. Sakaguchi! Dr. Aqua!”

zh_CN: 「早上好。昨晚休息得怎么样？」
en: “Good morning. How did you sleep last night?”

zh_CN: 「还可以……肚子有点疼，翻身都要小心翼翼的。」
en: “All right... My tummy hurts a little. I have to be really careful even when turning over.”

zh_CN: 「这才第二天嘛。恢复过程还是要慢慢来。」
en: “It's only the next day. Recovery takes time.”

zh_CN: 「监护记录、检查结果和伤口情况目前都很好。今天主要确认恢复过程有没有不舒服的地方。」
en: “Your monitoring records, test results, and wound all look good so far. Today, we're mainly checking for any discomfort during recovery.”

zh_CN: 「那……昨天找到的东西，真的就是一直害我开刀的元凶？」
en: “Then... was what you found yesterday really the culprit behind all my operations?”

zh_CN: 「前两次处理的是它伸到盆腔里的部分。这次我们顺着它找到了肠系膜里的来源，把相连的病灶一起取掉了。病理结果还要等，但这次确实不一样。」
en: “The first two times, we treated its extension into the pelvis. This time, we traced it back to its source in the mesentery and removed the connected lesion together. We're still waiting for pathology, but this time really is different.”

zh_CN: 「所以这次不用再担心，真正的源头是不是还藏在别处啦！」
en: “So this time, you don't need to worry that the real source is still hiding somewhere else!”
“...Ohh... Finally!”

zh_CN: 【千早长长呼出一口气，几乎要哭出来。】
en: [Chihaya lets out a long breath, nearly in tears.]

zh_CN: 「妈呀，我这辈子真的再也不想开刀了！」
en: “Oh my gosh, I never want surgery again for the rest of my life!”

zh_CN: 「哈哈哈！这次不用再安排第四次了！」
en: “Hahaha! We don't need to schedule a fourth one this time!”

zh_CN: 「阿库娅医生！请你不要再说『第四次』这个词啦！！」
en: “Dr. Aqua! Please stop saying ‘fourth time’!!”

zh_CN: 「哈哈。接下来专心恢复，按计划复查就行。」
en: “Haha. Now just focus on recovering and keep your follow-up appointments.”
“...Okay.”

zh_CN: 【她抹了抹眼角，很快又恢复了平时的活泼。】
en: [She wipes the corners of her eyes and soon regains her usual liveliness.]

zh_CN: 【病房门口传来轻轻的敲门声。杉村弘子走了进来。】
en: [A soft knock comes at the door. Hiroko Sugimura enters.]

zh_CN: 「听说千早小姐昨天的手术很顺利，我顺路来看看。身体怎么样？」
en: “I heard your operation went very well yesterday, Miss Chihaya, so I stopped by. How are you feeling?”

zh_CN: 「啊！弘子姐姐！我好多了，就是一笑肚子还有点疼。」
en: “Ah! Hiroko! Much better, except my tummy still hurts a little when I laugh.”

zh_CN: 「那就慢慢来。我还记得第一次那回，你从手术室跑出来，我在走廊里追了你好远。」
en: “Take your time, then. I still remember that first time, when you ran out of the operating room and I chased you so far down the corridor.”

zh_CN: 「……呜，为什么连弘子姐姐也要提那件事啦！」
en: “...Ugh, why do you have to bring that up, too?!”

zh_CN: 「说起来，我第一次认识弘子，就是因为千早那次从手术室逃跑。」
en: “Come to think of it, I first met Hiroko because Chihaya ran away from the operating room.”

zh_CN: 「弘子追着你出来，我们那时才说上话。」
en: “Hiroko came chasing after you. That was when we first spoke.”

zh_CN: 「等等！这么说来……我岂不是你们的介绍人？！」
en: “Wait! Then... doesn't that make me the person who introduced you?!”

zh_CN: 「呵呵，这么说好像也没错。」
en: “Hehe, I suppose that's one way to put it.”

zh_CN: 「那我第一次逃跑，原来还做了一件好事嘛！」
en: “So my first escape actually did some good!”

zh_CN: 「不过，可别为了再介绍别人，又从手术室跑出去哦。」
en: “But don't run out of the operating room again just to introduce someone else.”

zh_CN: 「才不会啦！最好以后都不用再上手术台了！」
en: “I won't! Hopefully I'll never need an operating table again!”

zh_CN: 「那就好好养病。下次见面，希望是在手术室以外的地方。」
en: “Then concentrate on getting better. Next time we meet, I hope it's somewhere other than the operating room.”

zh_CN: 「我也是这么希望的！」
en: “That's what I'm hoping, too!”

zh_CN: 【弘子笑着向众人道别，离开病房。】
en: [Hiroko smiles, says goodbye to everyone, and leaves the room.]

zh_CN: 「对了，这次还有一个要好好感谢的人。御園医生那份影像判断帮了很大的忙。」
en: “There's someone else we should thank properly. Dr. Misono's imaging assessment helped us a great deal.”

zh_CN: 「啊，对啦！芹香医生今天一大早还来看我了！」
en: “Oh, right! Dr. Serika came to see me really early this morning!”

zh_CN: 「……御園医生？」
en: “...Dr. Misono?”

zh_CN: 「嗯！比你们还早！她问我昨晚睡得怎么样、有没有哪里特别疼，还叮嘱我别逞强。」
en: “Yes! Before you! She asked how I'd slept, whether anything hurt especially badly, and told me not to push myself.”

zh_CN: 「她特地来病房？」
en: “She made a special trip to the ward?”

zh_CN: 「对呀。她说只是顺路看看，可是超级细心！我昨天不是说过，她在手术室里陪我聊了好多事情吗？」
en: “Yes. She said she was just stopping by, but she was so attentive! Didn't I tell you yesterday how much she talked with me in the operating room?”

zh_CN: 「哦～御園医生居然会主动跑来探病呀！」
en: “Ohh, Dr. Misono came to visit on her own initiative!”

zh_CN: 「……她现在是在影像科工作，按理说不需要负责术后查房。」
en: “...She works in radiology now. Technically, postoperative rounds aren't her responsibility.”

zh_CN: 「所以我才觉得她很温柔嘛！」
en: “That's why I think she's so kind!”

zh_CN: 「而且她以前还弹过贝斯！我真的没想到！芹香医生以前一定是个很酷的大姐姐！」
en: “And she used to play bass! I really never expected it! Dr. Serika must have been such a cool older girl!”

zh_CN: 「哎呀，我都不知道这件事。」
en: “Oh my, I didn't know that.”

zh_CN: 「……我也不知道。」
en: “...Neither did I.”

zh_CN: 「咦？你们不是同事吗？」
en: “Huh? Aren't you colleagues?”

zh_CN: 「是同事。」
en: “We are.”

zh_CN: 「那你们平常都聊些什么呀？」
en: “Then what do you usually talk about?”

zh_CN: 「……主要是病例和影像。」
en: “...Mostly cases and imaging.”

zh_CN: 「噗！难怪啦！坂口医生，你要是只跟女孩子谈工作，当然很难知道人家以前有什么兴趣嘛！」
en: “Pfft! No wonder! Dr. Sakaguchi, if you only talk about work with girls, of course you won't learn what they used to enjoy!”

zh_CN: 「哈哈哈哈！这次我赞成千早小姐！」
en: “Hahahaha! I'm with Miss Chihaya on this one!”

zh_CN: 「……我怎么成了被教育的那个。」
en: “...How did I end up being the one getting lectured?”

zh_CN: 「总之，今天先不要想着跑来跑去了。你恢复得不错，但还需要住院观察几天。」
en: “Anyway, don't think about running around today. You're recovering well, but you'll need a few more days of inpatient observation.”

zh_CN: 「放心啦！我现在就算想跑也跑不快。」
en: “Don't worry! Even if I wanted to run now, I couldn't go very fast.”

zh_CN: 「哈哈，这样倒是省得去走廊抓你了。」
en: “Haha, that saves us from having to catch you in the corridor.”

zh_CN: 「你们怎么总爱提我逃跑的事啊！」
en: “Why do you always bring up my escapes?!”

zh_CN: 「因为你确实跑过两次。」
en: “Because you did run away twice.”

zh_CN: 「第三次没有！这次我真的没跑！」
en: “Not the third time! I really didn't run this time!”

zh_CN: 「嗯。这一次，你做得很好。」
en: “Yes. This time, you did very well.”

zh_CN: 【千早愣了一下，然后很得意地笑起来。】
en: [Chihaya pauses, then breaks into a very proud smile.]

zh_CN: 「嘿嘿。那是当然！」
en: “Hehe. Of course I did!”

zh_CN: 【坂口与阿库娅离开病房。画面淡出。】
en: [Sakaguchi and Aqua leave the room. Fade out.]
